values.note: Every site has water and 50-amp electric; only 4 of the 79 (sites 09, 26, 69 and 70) also have sewer.

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232711 ('79 public campsites with full water and electric hookups') + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232711 (all 79 sites Electricity Hookup 50 / Water Hookup Yes; Sewer Hookup Y on 09, 26, 69, 70), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 79 public sites (plus 2 park-attendant sites), 30 pull-through; listed vehicle lengths 30-60 ft, most 40-50. One wheeled camping unit per site, parked on the impact pad; up to 10 campers per site.

sites.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232711 ('2 park attendant campsites, 79 public campsites'; notices on one wheeled unit and 10 campers) + recreation.gov campsite catalog for 232711 (Max Vehicle Length 30-60; Driveway Entry Pull-through 30), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232711 ('6 comfort stations (4 with showers), 1 dump station'; amenities Flush Toilets, Showers, Dump Station), read 2026-10-21

values.note: Run by the Corps' Hartwell Project with park attendants. Reservable on recreation.gov up to the day of arrival; one site (02) is not reservable online. 14 nights in any 30 days. Gate locked 10 pm-7 am, so check in before 10 pm; check-in 3 pm, check-out 2 pm.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232711 (rules: maxStay 14 'Rolling 30 Days', reservationCutOff 0 days; notices on the gate, check-in/out and the 14-day limit) + campsite catalog (site 02 reservable: false), read 2026-10-21

values.note: 2026 Peak Season (April 1-October 30): $36 for the one 'RV Electric' site, $38 for a standard water/electric site; the table also carries unnamed site rates of $36, $42, $44 and $76.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232711/rates (2026 Peak Season: 'PeakRV ELECTRIC' 36, 'PeakSTANDARD ELECTRIC' 38, two unnamed rates 36 and 42, two coded STANDARD ELECTRIC rates 44 and 76), read 2026-10-21

summary: Confirmed $36-42 (2026), 50-amp + water at all 79 sites (sewer at only 4, now noted), reservable on recreation.gov. Added the Corps' April 1-Oct 31 season, 79 sites to 60 ft with 30 pull-throughs, showers/flush toilets/dump, 14-night limit. AWH note kept. Not stated: booking window, senior-pass acceptance (rec.gov's bare 'militaryDiscount' rule has no wording; discounts left alone).
